claim: TWO-NN intrinsic dimension estimator is subset-density dependent (R14 confirmed). For n=200-500 plans per indicator subset in 10-D Hellinger DMAP space: TWO-NN biased LOW for sparse subsets (GDP TNN=2.52 vs D2=4.11 vs LB=18.5) and HIGH for concentrated subsets (Phillips TNN=7.79 vs D2=3.95 vs LB=16.4). D2 is bimodal at our n. DMAP-eigenspectrum saturates. Only Levina-Bickel gives stable per-indicator trajectory (CV 0.07-0.25).

β1 persistent-homology significance is consistently >2.0σ for the Phillips curve subset (mean β1_z=2.28), indicating real loop topology in inflation/unemployment plan manifold. GDP only develops β1 topology at the 2007-2008 transition (-0.53 to 1.63, σ=2.1). Macro manifold has a non-trivial Phillips-curve loop other indicators lack.

claim_structured.interpretation: Phillips curve loop is a topological feature of the macro manifold; GDP acquires similar topology only at GFC

claim: L2 micro-structure descriptor parquets computed for all 12 recapitulation tests via streaming HDF5 scan of gw_pair_cache.h5. Each parquet contains 8 closed-form descriptors per (i,j) transport plan: marginal drift QC, excess entropy, spectral gap (via SVD per R07), effective rank, L1 distance to independence, max element, off-diagonal mass, and von Neumann entropy. 100% cache hit rate, 100% QC pass rate (marginal drift < 5e-3) across all ~448K plans. Total wall ~38 min single-process.

L4 coupling test: 8 of 12 recapitulation tests have at least one transport-plan descriptor distinguishing coupling pairs from non-coupling pairs at BH-FDR alpha=0.05 (1000-permutation null). THREE descriptors are UNIVERSALLY significant across ALL 8 testable tests: excess_entropy, l1_to_independence, vN_entropy. Direction of effect is consistent: coupled pairs have higher excess entropy + lower vN entropy + smaller GW distance, indicating coupling appears as tighter, more structured transport plans. The 4 non-testable tests (global_macro, ppp, uk_nuts, us_personal_credit) all have only 2 declared groups so the coupling-vs-noncoupling distinction does not exist for them.

claim_structured.direction_effect: coupled pairs have HIGHER excess entropy, LOWER vN entropy, SMALLER GW distance

claim: L3 vintage proxy: 4 of 12 recapitulation tests show vintage-dependent intrinsic dimension. Long-history series (top half by n_points) carry MORE stable modes than short-history series (bottom half) for okun_law (long d=5 vs short d=2, delta=+3), fama_french (4 vs 2), uk_nuts (5 vs 3), and us_personal_credit (6 vs 4). Direction is consistent with longer histories sampling more macroeconomic regimes and acquiring richer intrinsic dynamical structure. THIS IS NOT A REGIME-DATE TEST. The proxy cannot detect specific transitions like Volcker 1978 or GFC 2008 without precise series start dates. Promotion gated on follow-on AoA-32-series-dates bead.

claim: L5-A merge tree (Ward in eigvec space): only 2 of 12 recapitulation tests have a K=2 cut that matches the binarized macro labels at p<0.05 vs label-permutation null (okun_law ARI=0.325, phillips_curve ARI=0.059). For the OTHER 10 tests, the dominant K=2 axis in the centered Gram does NOT align with the largest-vs-other label binarization. This is consistent with L1 (F-008): the dominant slow-mode axis is label-aligned for some tests but is some other axis (likely source/timescale identity per the 5.10x slow/fast ratio of source) for the rest. NOT a pipeline failure but a structural finding about WHICH axis dominates the leading mode in each test.

claim: L5-B Phillips H_1 ANTI-REPLICATION: the static all-to-all Gromov-Wasserstein distance matrix for the phillips_curve recapitulation subset (N=302) does NOT contain persistent H_1 loops. Observed beta_1 = 0 at the 0.10*diam threshold; the largest H_1 persistence in the diagram is 0.00091 vs threshold 0.0703 (78x too small). F-005 found a Phillips loop topology with beta_1 z=2.28 using rolling-window causal-barycenter plans. The two methods measure DIFFERENT TOPOLOGY: F-005s loop is a TRAJECTORY feature (the macro state cycling through inflation/unemployment regimes over time), while L5-B was testing a CONFIGURATION feature (the spatial arrangement of Phillips-related series in attractor space). Both findings are correct; they describe different aspects of the same underlying dynamics. This is a CAVEAT update to F-005, not a refutation.

claim_structured.interpretation: F-005 is a TRAJECTORY topology finding; L5-B tested CONFIGURATION topology; they measure different things
claim_structured.recommended_action: update F-005 record with scope qualifier: rolling-window-trajectory feature

claim: AoA-40a Lorenz pilot validates the pairwise GW forecaster pipeline on a controlled toy system. With shifted z-coordinate Lorenz pairs (z2 = z1 shifted by L steps + Gaussian noise, L in {1,3,5}, 10 trials each, plus 10 null trials of independent Lorenz pairs), the full pipeline achieves: leader recovery 1.00 (D_ij sign correctly identifies z1 as leader on 30/30 signal trials), lag recovery 1.00 (best_lag matches true L exactly on every trial), MSE pass rate 0.93 vs 2x optimal, signal-to-noise 1.00 (V-TRAJ variance > 10% raw on every leader), null FDR 0.00 (no false-positive leader detection on independent pairs), Sinkhorn marginal error <1e-5 throughout. H1, H2, H3 all validated on this controlled case. Two structural test-design bugs found and fixed during iteration: (1) Lorenz Z2 wing-flip symmetry breaks V-TRAJ correlation when x is the observable; using z (Z2-invariant) fixes it. (2) Diffusive coupling C*(x1-x2) is instantaneous synchronization, not delay coupling; the AoA cannot recover a lag that does not exist, so the test must use explicit time-shifted observables. Both lessons updated in AoA_prediction.tex sec 4.1 implementation note.

claim_structured.pipeline_speed: 6.9s wallclock for 40 trials with 100% cache hit; 26.2s on first build (40 cache misses)
claim_structured.gw_solver_args: POT entropic_gromov_wasserstein eps=0.01 n_sup=40 max_iter=5000 tol=1e-9 cost_normalized_to_unit

observable choice matters for symmetric attractors
